meta.name: ecommerce-full-pipeline
meta.description: 电商运营在开展跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏业务时，若需解决选品难、上架繁琐等痛点，必用此技能！一键打通“爆品挖掘→1688采集→多平台上架→推广文案→短视频生成”全自动流水线，轻松实现端到端自动化，让开店运营效率翻倍。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成从爆品挖掘到上架推广的电商全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏，想省掉选品上架的繁琐
copy.tagline_en: Automate the full ecommerce flow from product discovery to listing and promotion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do cross-border or Xianyu sales and want to skip manual listing.

howto.what: 它让 Claude 能通过命令行跑电商流水线:从 1688 采集并清洗商品、生成上架模板与推广文案、合成竖屏短视频,还能搜闲鱼捡漏、一键代发。
howto.when: 当你提到要做跨境电商的选品、上架、推广等环节,或想在闲鱼淘二手捡漏时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 auto-pipeline 挖掘收纳盒爆品,并生成上架模板和推广视频
say.note: 按关键词跑全自动流水线并输出文件

say.text: 在闲鱼搜 999 元以内的 4K 投影仪,按捡漏评分推荐
say.note: 返回评分排序后的闲鱼商品列表

say.text: 把这件 1688 商品一键代发,收件人信息我发你
say.note: 按给定收货信息生成代发下单

howto.what_en: Lets Claude run a command-line e-commerce pipeline: scrape and clean 1688 products, generate listing templates and promo copy, render vertical videos, hunt Xianyu bargains and auto-fulfill orders.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want cross-border e-commerce work such as product selection, listing, promotion, video creation, or second-hand bargain hunting on Xianyu.

say_en.text: Run auto-pipeline to find storage-box hits, then make listings and videos
say_en.note: Runs the full pipeline and writes output files

say_en.text: Search Xianyu for 4K projectors under 999 and rank them by bargain score
say_en.note: Returns a scored Xianyu product list

say_en.text: Fulfill this 1688 item for me; I'll send the receiver details
say_en.note: Places the dropship order with your details
